title: TikTok: The credit card minimum payment trap (animated)
_sources: Fed G.19 (Oct 7, 2026 release): credit card APR, accounts assessed interest, Q2 2026 = 22.15%. Minimum payment: 1% of balance + interest, at least $40 (Chase). Own calculation $5,000 at 22.15%: first minimum $142.29 (interest $92.29); minimum only -> 184 months (15.3 y), interest $7,516, total $12,516; fixed $150/month -> 53 months (4.4 y), interest $2,834.

lines.text: Five thousand dollars on a credit card can cost you over twelve thousand.
The average card charges about twenty-two percent interest.
Your first minimum payment is about one forty. But ninety-two of it is just interest.
And as your balance shrinks, so does the minimum.
Pay only that, and you are stuck for about fifteen years.
Paying over seven thousand dollars in interest.
Keep paying one-fifty a month instead? Done in under five years.
So before you pay just the minimum, remember:
